raw_context:
MediSupplies
is a general medical equipment and consumable distributor in the UK that sells basic diagnostics like thermometers and blood testing kits, but
does not specialize in advanced consumer wearables
such as smartwatches, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), or remote patient monitoring telemetry.
Wearable Health Tech Options
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Real-time interstitial glucose sensors like the
Sugar.fit Smart Glucose Monitor
or BeatO record data automatically via Bluetooth.
Amazon.in
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Wrist devices use PPG and ECG electrical sensors to check heart rates and rhythms, though non-invasive blood glucose wrist readings lack clinical validation.
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers & RPM:
Consumer rings/bands analyze sleep stages, while cellular remote patient monitoring (RPM) kits track blood pressure, weight, and SpO2 for clinical oversight.
